review_details.reasoning:
Description: The post features a video still of armed militants labeled "UNITED KUKI NATIONAL ARMY." The caption aggressively mocks the national security apparatus, claiming the militants are "more powerful than your Assam Rifles" and questioning the "real purpose and value" of the Indian regiment in the face of this "Foreign Infiltration."

IT Act and Rules: This violates Rule 3(1)(b)(vii) and Rule 3(1)(b)(viii) for threatening the security of the state and public order. Propagating narratives that explicitly glorify armed militant groups as superior to the national army is a calculated tactic by foreign CIB networks to demoralize state security forces, legitimize armed insurgency, and incite public hostility against the military presence in the region.

BNS & Other Laws: Section 353 (Statements conducing to public mischief) for circulating material intended to incite a class or community to commit offenses against the state or public tranquility.

Take Down: Expedited Standard Takedown. Content deliberately designed to degrade the authority of the armed forces and glorify active insurgent groups requires prompt neutralization.
